notes: Rule 29 fronting and its proper-name rider: בֵּית הַבַּעַל → 'the house of Baal' and כֹּהֵן הַבַּעַל → 'the priest of Baal' render the arthrous rectum with no determiner and write one 'the' before the construct, so the article on הַבַּעַל takes that 'the' (as בְּנֵי הָרָמָה → 'The children of Ramah') and the construct keeps its bare noun.
